title: Start shallow, still reach the depth
hook: A search can repeat itself to control how deep its answer may be.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Repeat depth-limited search to obtain a shallowest solution with depth-first memory.

misconception: Repeating earlier depths is always slower than searching deeply once.
objective: Repeat depth-limited search to obtain a shallowest solution with depth-first memory.

claims.text: Each pass performs depth-first search but refuses to descend beyond its current limit. Earlier passes revisit nodes; increasing the limit one level at a time finds a shallowest goal in an unweighted tree while keeping a depth-first path.
